intervention_type: additive contrastive activation addition (CAA) at residual block 28 during autoregressive DNA generation

A_steering_coefficient_sweep.unit_stated: raw multiplier on the diff-of-means CAA vector; vector norm recorded (vnorm=823.91 in results/m3/s28_caa.json)
A_steering_coefficient_sweep.capability_metric_logged: validity_rate + mean Evo2 NLL (naturalness) logged at every sweep point alongside helix (Pareto / joint scoring)
A_steering_coefficient_sweep.coefficient_locked: coef 1.0, locked by the pre-registered validity-frontier rule = max helix_all s.t. validity non-inferiority (results/m3/winning.json, results/m4/validity_frontier.json). A principled joint-criterion lock, not an ad-hoc pick.
A_steering_coefficient_sweep.random_direction_control: matched_control (orthogonalized same-norm random direction) shows no gain (-0.024, n.s.); same-norm permuted sham shows no gain (-0.005, n.s.). Both present.
A_steering_coefficient_sweep.geometric_range: coefs [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0] -> 16x largest-to-smallest nonzero, 6 points, alpha=0 baseline included. The run MET its criteria (significant monotone dose-response rho=0.922, q=1.5e-4; helix gain at winning coef), so the >=30x wide-sweep requirement (which applies only where a run fell short) does not bind.
A_steering_coefficient_sweep.finding: Textbook steering-coefficient sweep: unit stated, capability/validity co-logged at every point, principled frontier lock, random-direction and sham controls both present, alpha=0 in-run baseline. Criteria met at a small conservative coefficient.

notes: Location (M2 probe/SAE screen) is decodability-only and correctly feeds -- not substitutes for -- the causal steering; C1 rests on the causal dose-response, not on probe R^2 (which was near-zero, honestly reported).
